headline: Tabled Peck Middle School closeout resolutions; approved an AI task force and removal of 21 policies.
summary: Staff reported on the first day of school, including fire drill timing, students placed on wrong buses, and educator licensure waiver denials. Facilities staff said the district invested more than $35 million in summer projects. A public speaker asked for a living wage for paraprofessionals.
decisions: Tabled the Peck closeout resolutions on performance benchmarking and building maintenance, passed unanimously.
Approved letting the chair establish an Ad Hoc AI Taskforce Committee, passed unanimously.
Referred the Final Principal Increase SY26-27 Performance to Finance and Operations, passed unanimously.
Approved the proposed school committee meeting calendar, passed unanimously.
Referred to the Policy and Governance Subcommittee the teen dating violence policy required by M.G.L. c. 71, § 2C, passed unanimously.
Approved out-of-state travel for Yaraliz Soto to Montgomery, Alabama, October 5-9, 2026, passed unanimously.
Approved travel for four members to the Massachusetts Association of School Committees in Danvers, November 4-7, 2026, by a 7-0 vote with 2 abstentions.
Accepted the Warrant Report 8.24.26 for warrants MT-05-26, REG0726A-C, and REG0826C, passed unanimously.
Directed the Policy and Governance Subcommittee to develop a policy for all School Committee subcommittees, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy EBAB, Pest Management, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy EBCD, Emergency Closing, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy ECA, Building and Grounds Security, passed unanimously.
Referred Policy EHAA, District Security Relating to Technology, to the policy subcommittee, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy GBA, Equal Employment Opportunity, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy GBD, School Community-Staff Communications, 8 yes and 1 no.
Approved first reading of Policy GBEB, Staff Conduct, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy KBBA, Non-Custodial Parent, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy KBE, Relations with Parent Organizations, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy KBG, Parent Advisory Councils, passed unanimously.
Approved first reading of Policy KHA, Public Solicitations in the Schools, passed unanimously.
Referred Policy DJ, Purchasing, back to the Policy Subcommittee, passed unanimously.
Tabled Policy DK, Payment Procedures, passed unanimously.
Approved second and final reading of Policy DKC, Expense Reimbursement, passed unanimously.
Failed 3-6 an amendment to restore cross-out language on student ID badges in Policy EBB-R.
Tabled Policy EBB-R, Safety and Security Plan, passed unanimously.
Approved second and final reading of Policy EC, Building and Grounds Management, passed unanimously.
Approved second and final reading of Policy EFE, Civil Rights Complaint Policy for Child Nutrition Programs, passed unanimously.
Approved second and final reading of Policy FFA, Memorials, passed unanimously.
Approved second and final reading of Policy JFBB, School Choice, passed unanimously.
Approved second and final reading of Policy KA-1, School and Community Relations Goals, passed unanimously.
Approved removing 21 policies as a package, including KF-E-3 fee schedule for school facilities, passed unanimously.
